@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, Request
+from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPDigest, OpenIdConnect
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+import pytest
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+bearer_scheme = HTTPBearer()
+digest_scheme = HTTPDigest()
+oidc_scheme = OpenIdConnect(openIdConnectUrl="https://example.com")
+
+@app.get("/bearer")
+async def read_bearer(token=Depends(bearer_scheme)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+@app.get("/digest")
+async def read_digest(token=Depends(digest_scheme)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+@app.get("/oidc")
+async def read_oidc(token=Depends(oidc_scheme)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_bearer_no_auth():
+    response = client.get("/bearer")
+    assert response.status_code == 401
+    assert response.headers["www-authenticate"] == "Bearer"
+    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Not authenticated"
+
+def test_bearer_wrong_scheme():
+    response = client.get("/bearer", headers={"Authorization": "Basic abc"})
+    assert response.status_code == 401
+    assert response.headers["www-authenticate"] == "Bearer"
+    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Invalid authentication credentials"
+
+def test_bearer_success():
+    response = client.get("/bearer", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer abc"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+
+def test_digest_no_auth():
+    response = client.get("/digest")
+    assert response.status_code == 401
+    assert response.headers["www-authenticate"] == "Digest"
+    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Not authenticated"
+
+def test_digest_wrong_scheme():
+    response = client.get("/digest", headers={"Authorization": "Basic abc"})
+    assert response.status_code == 401
+    assert response.headers["www-authenticate"] == "Digest"
+    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Invalid authentication credentials"
+
+def test_digest_success():
+    response = client.get("/digest", headers={"Authorization": "Digest abc"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+
+def test_oidc_no_auth():
+    response = client.get("/oidc")
+    assert response.status_code == 401
+    assert response.headers["www-authenticate"] == "Bearer"
+    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Not authenticated"
+
+def test_oidc_success():
+    response = client.get("/oidc", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer abc"})
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import pytest
+    pytest.main([__file__])
